readings.Aries: The fire in you burns cleaner when it has an actual purpose. Find the purpose first. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Taurus: The disagreement is not about the thing. It is about who gets to decide. Know which battle you're having. Let this one be easy.
readings.Gemini: Your cross-talk with the world is high. Reduce cognitive load; something important is trying to get through. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Cancer: Something you said to comfort someone else is something you need to hear yourself. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Leo: The performance you're giving is excellent. There is something you're not saying behind it. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Virgo: The standard you hold for your work is a form of love. Make sure it's not the only form you're using. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Libra: The thing you gave up to keep the peace is asking to be returned. It's not too late to ask for it back. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Scorpio: What you love, you love completely, and you never fully stop. This is a fact of your chemistry. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Sagittarius: Your optimism sometimes arrives before the data. Today the data is there. Let it inform the optimism. The first instinct was right.
readings.Capricorn: Something you built is worth protecting. Make sure you're protecting the right parts of it. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Aquarius: You are more affected by the people around you than your detachment makes it appear. That's not a flaw. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Pisces: You absorb the moods and needs of spaces and people automatically. Today, set down what you've absorbed. The window for this is shorter than it looks.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
